description: This file contains functions and configurations for managing wireless interfaces in OpenWrt's netifd system, including handling channels, encryption, interface setup, and driver initialization.

methods.name: add_driver
methods.description: Function to add a driver, implemented in dump case of init_wireless_driver.

methods.name: wireless_setup_vif_failed
methods.description: Handles failure in setting up a wireless VIF, outputs error message.

methods.name: wireless_setup_failed
methods.description: Handles general device setup failure, resets retry count.

methods.name: prepare_key_wep
methods.description: Prepares WEP key, converting to hex if necessary.

methods.name: _wdev_prepare_channel
methods.description: Prepares wireless channel parameters based on json input.

methods.name: _wdev_handler
methods.description: Calls driver-specific handler functions based on interface data.

methods.name: _wdev_msg_call
methods.description: Sets json namespace, calls a command, then restores namespace.

methods.name: _wdev_wrapper
methods.description: Creates wrapper functions for messaging.

methods.name: _wdev_notify_init
methods.description: Initializes notification JSON with command and device info.

methods.name: _wdev_notify
methods.description: Sends notification via ubus call.

methods.name: _wdev_add_variables
methods.description: Adds variables to JSON object.

methods.name: _wireless_add_vif
methods.description: Adds a virtual interface configuration.

methods.name: _wireless_add_vlan
methods.description: Adds a VLAN configuration.

methods.name: _wireless_set_up
methods.description: Sends command to set wireless interface up.

methods.name: _wireless_set_data
methods.description: Sends data configuration for wireless interface.

methods.name: _wireless_add_process
methods.description: Adds a process to the wireless configuration.

methods.name: _wireless_process_kill_all
methods.description: Kills all wireless processes.

methods.name: _wireless_set_retry
methods.description: Sets retry count for wireless setup.

methods.name: wireless_vif_parse_encryption
methods.description: Parses encryption settings for wireless VIF.

methods.name: _wireless_set_brsnoop_isolation
methods.description: Configures bridge snooping and isolation.

methods.name: for_each_interface
methods.description: Iterates over wireless interfaces and applies a callback.

methods.name: for_each_vlan
methods.description: Iterates over VLANs and applies a callback.

methods.name: for_each_station
methods.description: Iterates over stations and applies a callback.

methods.name: _wdev_common_device_config
methods.description: Adds common device configuration options.

methods.name: _wdev_common_iface_config
methods.description: Adds common interface configuration options.

methods.name: _wdev_common_vlan_config
methods.description: Adds common VLAN configuration options.

methods.name: _wdev_common_station_config
methods.description: Adds common station configuration options.

methods.name: init_wireless_driver
methods.description: Initializes wireless driver with dump, setup, or teardown commands.
